_meta.purpose: Candidate additional sources to close specific CSS (Central Superior Services Examination, Pakistan/FPSC) knowledge-base coverage gaps identified from Task 12's real, human-judged retrieval results against the approved 972-chunk baseline. CSS here always means the FPSC civil-service exam, never Cascading Style Sheets. This catalog is separate from, and does not modify, research/colab/sources.json (the 18 sources already in the approved baseline).
_meta.method: Every URL was fetched directly (curl) and, for PDFs/HTML, text was actually extracted (PyMuPDF / trafilatura, same tools the existing notebook pipeline uses) and inspected -- not accepted from a search-result snippet alone. A candidate that returned a non-200 status, a client-rendered shell with no extractable text, or content that did not actually match the claimed topic (checked by reading the extracted text) was moved to excluded_or_failed rather than included.
_meta.scope_note: This round targeted 10 specific priority gaps plus 3 secondary gaps identified from Task 12's retrieval_relevance.csv and evaluation_dataset.jsonl (see research/evaluation/task14/source_coverage_matrix.csv for the full gap-by-gap accounting). It is not a general source-expansion effort.

web_sources.subject: Current Affairs
